exposure: mode of birth (elective cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 166 pregnant women aged 18-40 years in their third trimester, and their infants, followed up to 18 months.
finding: Maternal serum Apelin-36 level after delivery was positively correlated with infant weight at 12 and 18 months, infant height at 6 and 18 months, and infant head circumference at 12 months.
